title: Onboard verdantx-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Asha Patel
description: Onboard verdantx-13b v1.0 into the registry with curated metadata, validated performance profiles, and an automated changelog entry. Motivation: VerdantX is a high-throughput 13B variant that has strong accuracy/latency tradeoffs for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) workloads. This PR adds model metadata, two perf profiles (low-latency and cost-optimized), integration tests, and wires the automated changelog generator so new model releases create a release note draft. Implementation notes: - metadata.json contains model schema, tokenizer, supported precisions, recommended quantization profiles, and expected KV/cache behavior. - perf_profiles.yaml includes measured tail-latency p95/p99, throughput (tokens/s) on our standard GPU pools, and evaluator prompts used to generate the profiles. - scripts/changelog/auto_update_registry.py is extended to pick up new model directories and append templated release notes to changelog/_pending. - tests include a CI smoke test and end-to-end performance validation harness against a small subset of workload prompts. Checklist: - [x] Add metadata file - [x] Add perf profiles + measurement notes - [x] Add changelog automation hook - [x] Add integration tests - [x] Docs: short model page + runtime hints - [x] CI green on first run Known limitations: perf numbers were measured on r4-gpu-standard (A800/48GB) internal lab; customers on A10G/3090 may see different absolute throughput. Follow-ups: schedule cross-hardware perf runs (ENG-4191) and add quantization microbenchmarks for 4-bit profiles.
